card.name: Digits inside codes and identifiers
card.fires_on: A single digit (mostly 5, also 6 or 8) inside a code or identifier, such as an insulin strength like U-500, an asteroid name like YU55, a course code, or a URL-encoded string.

modes.label: Insulin strength codes

modes.label: Encoded URL strings
modes.description: A digit within a percent-encoded web address.
